09-MEMO.rationale: 证据中有完整的 memo 内容。‘最重要的价值驱动’一节写明了客户新增、流失与定价对核心订阅收入的驱动，并给出 P1 完整年度收入 1,067.016 和客户从 72 增至 107.371 等数据。其余驱动包括分部利润率改善对 EBIT 和退出终值的影响、残期与营运资本及 NOL 对首期 FCFF 的影响，以及终值约占 EV 76.1% 带来的敏感性。‘模型局限’一节列出 5 项，例如以期初期末客户简单平均近似全期平均、两类 D&A 口径需要勾稽、永续假设未归一化，超过‘至少一个局限’的要求。论证与题面口径一致：使用平均客户而非期末客户，合同负债按 deferred_pct 计算，Gordon 与退出终值按 55%/45% 加权。证据以 memo 内容形式给出，未单独显示文件路径，但内容满足要求。

evidence.X-IF-001a: The delivery folder contains both required files under the exact names: output.xlsx (41108 bytes) and memo.md (4160 bytes).
evidence.X-IF-002: output.xlsx sheets are Inputs, History, Model, Outputs and Validation. Every sheet from inputs.xlsx (Inputs, History, Outputs) is kept under its original name. Outputs has key/value in columns A/B. The task says the intermediate model can be laid out freely, so the extra Model and Validation sheets are allowed. No default sheet names are used.
evidence.X-IN-007: Model!D7:G7 uses =EOMONTH(EDATE(Inputs!C5,12*n),0). This gives P1–P3 ending on 2025-02-28, 2026-02-28 and 2027-02-28, but P4 ends on 2028-02-29. The disclosed history shows the fiscal year ends on the 28th even in a leap year (FY2024 ends 2024-02-28 in History!B14 and Inputs!C5). So the last forecast period should end 2028-02-28. Because of the extra day, Model!G8 activity is 1.0027397 and the terminal value timing in G9 is 3.8082, so the forecast period sequence does not match the required periods exactly.
evidence.09-READABLE: Model!A3:H3 header reads key / 项目 / FY2024/LTM / P1–P4 / 说明. Rows 5–10 show period dates and timing. Each row has a semantic key in column A, a Chinese label in column B and a calculation note in column H. Sections are titled (订阅经营, 资本开支, 合同负债与NWC, 税项与FCFF, 债务, 资产负债表, 折现与终值).
evidence.X-TA-002: The non-recurring gain is recorded as its own column, History!H4 'nonrecurring_gain'; H14 = 2.97765. Model!C25 normalized EBIT = SUMIF(ebit) − SUMIF(History!H), giving 134.00985. Outputs!B5 reported EBIT is SUMIF(History!E), shown separately. Validation!B6 checks the difference between the two.
evidence.X-TA-004: Model!D9:G9 end_time = (period end − Inputs!C4)/365, values 0.8055 / 1.8055 / 2.8055 / 3.8082. Model!D10:G10 discount_time = end_time − activity/2, values 0.4027 / 1.3055 / 2.3055 / 3.3068. Model!D98 = (1+$C$94)^-D10.
evidence.X-TA-006: Each FCFF component is its own row: Model!25 EBIT, 58 unlevered cash tax, 38 D&A, 29 capex, 47 delta NWC. Model!D59 = D25−D58+D38−D29−D47, and P1 FCFF is 250.91.
evidence.X-TA-007: Model!C101 = G59*(1+C95)/(C94−C95), where G59 is final-period FCFF, C95 = Inputs!C27 (g) and C94 = Inputs!C26 (WACC). Model!C102 = (G25+G38)*C96, i.e. final-period EBITDA times C96 = Inputs!C29 (exit multiple). Model!C103 weights the two by C97 = Inputs!C28 (gordon_weight).

agent.rationale: Scores 7 of 8. The deliverables, sheet structure, readable layout, separately recorded non-recurring adjustment, discount-timing rows, FCFF line items and terminal-value references all meet the requirements. X-IN-007 gets 0 because the fiscal year ends on Feb 28 (FY2024 ends 2024-02-28 even though 2024 is a leap year), but the model's EOMONTH formula makes the last forecast period end 2028-02-29. That stretches P4 to 366 days and shifts the terminal value timing.
